summary: This directory centralizes the infrastructure for managing and processing UI-related errors. It provides a standardized framework for categorizing, configuring, and executing error handling logic, ensuring consistent user feedback and recovery strategies across the application.
responsibilities: Defining standardized UI error handling configurations
Mapping specific display categories to appropriate error handlers
Providing context and callbacks for error resolution
Verifying error handling behavior through automated testing
relationships: The UI error handler uses the error handler map to select the appropriate response based on the error's display category.
The error context encapsulates both the configuration and the retry logic required for an error handler to execute.
Automated test suites validate the error handling logic to ensure consistent behavior across different error scenarios.
designDecisions: Strategy pattern for mapping error categories to handlers
Configuration-based approach for defining error display behavior
Separation of error definitions from execution logic
Co-location of unit tests with corresponding error handling logic
